subject: fixing the findings of the published skill's test (journal Round 9), through a max-effort design review

design_review.verdict: do not ship the generic URL exposure; prefer route-specific references and reviewed option lists

dispositions.P0 URL disclosure (generic links, allowl: adopted: route-specific refs, digits only, portal origin only, unparsable URLs never echoed
dispositions.P0 existing header-boundary defect (star: adopted: exact origins, manual redirects, rows only from the descriptor's host, discover.js likewise
dispositions.P1 options need per-filter permission: adopted: option_filters per entry (rankings weight_class and level), validated items, search before the cap, UUID-shaped values skipped
dispositions.P1 requires_filter blocks options; prese: adopted: options mode bypasses row prerequisites; blank, null, [] and {} refused, zero accepted; hint from the catalogue
dispositions.P1 CLI sends every filter as a string: checked live: numeric items are coerced; arrays and objects returned no rows, so no typed input is needed
dispositions.P1 output bounds (bound() trims rows onl: adopted: finish first, then bound over rows and options, single oversized row dropped
dispositions.P1 stale runtime: adopted: version 2, snippet guard, discover.js checks version 2
dispositions.P2 keep F28 and F29 deferred: F28 handled as a JSON aggregate entry that counts memberships, not a text extractor; F29 stays a limitation
